title: Quantum processes are fine-scale geometry, gravitational ones large-scale

statements.text: Quantum processes are those of the fine-scale fractal structure of the invariant set, linked to diverging trajectories. Gravitational processes are its larger-scale heterogeneities, linked to converging trajectories. Every force, gravity included, is to be described by the total geometry of $I_U$.

sources.quote: "quantum" process are associated with fine-scale fractal geometry, "gravitational" process with larger-scale heterogeneous geometry
It is proposed that heterogeneities in the fractal geometry of I are manifestations of the phenomenon of gravity.
